card.name: Word after "risk of" in warnings
card.fires_on: The word right after "risk of" or "discontinuation of" in warning text, mainly "recurrent" in the NSAID heart-attack warning. Also the start of the brand name BIKTARVY and "premature" before closure.

modes.label: NSAID MI warning
modes.description: "recurrent" after "outweigh the risk of" in the recent heart attack warning.
modes.example: unless the benefits are expected to outweigh the risk of<< recurrent>> CV thrombotic events.

modes.label: BIKTARVY name start
modes.description: The first piece of the brand name BIKTARVY after "of".
modes.example: and may occur with discontinuation of<< B>>IKTARVY. Clos

modes.label: Premature closure
modes.description: "premature" after "increase the risk of" in the fetal ductus warning.
modes.example: increase the risk of<< premature>> closure of the fetal ductus arterios

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like restart and restarting, which fits "recurrent" events or stopping and resuming.
card.plain: It lights up on the word after "risk of" in warnings, especially "recurrent" before heart events.
